name: Uwai Takeru
source:
Yumi's husband.

Fell in love at first sight with Yumi, and his feelings still hasn't changed.

A tall, remarkably handsome man who is also highly educated. Hideki feels an inferiority complex towards him, because of how perfect he is. 

Because he graduated from the same university where Hideki studies, he wants to get along with him. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ239450.html]DLsite[/url]]
